bosses.name: Malachar the Undying
bosses.phaseMsg2: Malachar screams — his shield cracks. Phase 2: He summons a wall of undead fire!
bosses.phaseMsg3: The fire wall falls. Malachar stands exposed — ancient and furious!

bosses.name: The Bone Sovereign
bosses.phaseMsg2: The Bone Sovereign splinters — and rebuilds himself from the fallen dead around him!
bosses.phaseMsg3: His final form rises — a throne of bones animated by pure malice!

bosses.name: The Void Walker
bosses.phaseMsg2: The Void Walker tears a rift in reality itself. Phase 2: Reality warps around you!
bosses.phaseMsg3: The rift collapses inward. The Void Walker channels all of nothing at you!

bosses.name: The Crypt Tyrant
bosses.phaseMsg2: The Crypt Tyrant bellows — the walls crack and dead rise from the rubble!
bosses.phaseMsg3: His power peaks. Ancient runes ignite across his armour. Final phase!

bosses.name: The Pale Queen
bosses.phaseMsg2: The Pale Queen shrieks — her veil tears and reveals something ancient beneath!
bosses.phaseMsg3: She abandons grace entirely. Raw death magic pours from her hands!

rooms: The silence here is absolute. Your breathing sounds like a desecration.
Torch sconces line the walls — every flame extinguished long ago. Something put them out.
The floor is covered in a thin layer of ash. No footprints disturb it. Until now.
An inscription on the wall reads in an old tongue. One word stands out: "Wait."
A cold draft comes from nowhere. The hairs on your neck rise before you understand why.
The bones of a previous explorer lie here, still clutching a rusted blade.
Water drips somewhere in the dark. The rhythm is too regular. Too deliberate.
The room smells of old iron and something sweet that turns your stomach.
Carved faces watch you from the walls. Their expressions change when you look away.
You hear nothing. That is the problem. Even your footsteps are swallowed by the dark.
The ceiling here is low. You must hunch. Something about that feels intentional.
A broken altar stands in the center. Whatever was worshipped here, it was not light.
The walls are damp. The moisture is warm. You do not investigate further.
Crude marks scratched at eye level — a tally. You count two hundred and forty-three.
Every instinct screams to go back. You go forward.
The door behind you closes on its own. You did not touch it.
A lantern lies smashed on the floor. The oil has not dried. Someone was just here.
The room is perfectly square. That would be unremarkable if the dungeon were not round.
Cobwebs cover every surface. Not from spiders. The strands are too thick.
A chair sits in the center of the room. One leg is freshly broken. Recently.
The air here is wrong. Not cold, not warm. Absent. Like the room forgot to have weather.
You step on something soft. You do not look down.
The walls here are smooth — too smooth. Ground down by something larger than a hand.
A door on the far side is barricaded from this side. Someone wanted to keep something out.
The floor slopes slightly toward the center. The drain there is large enough to be concerning.
Text covers every inch of the walls. The same three words, repeated endlessly: "It is here."
A child's toy sits in the corner. It should not be here. Nothing small enough to own it should be here.
The shadows in the corners are the wrong shape. You count them twice. The number changes.
Something has been fed here regularly. You can tell by the stains.
The room gets quieter as you move toward the center. At the exact middle, there is no sound at all.
A mirror on the wall shows your reflection correctly. After a moment, it does not.
The room is warm. The warmth comes from below the floor. You do not dig.
Three doors. Two are sealed from the other side. You take the third.
The ceiling is painted with stars. They are not in any constellation you recognize.
Someone left a meal here. It is still warm. There is no one.
The dungeon has changed. You feel it. The walls breathe.
Everything here is wrong in ways you cannot name. You move quickly.
The air is thick with something old. It coats your lungs. You do not stop moving.
You have the sense of being watched by something that has been watching for centuries.
The room is larger than the dungeon should allow. Physics has stopped applying.
There are no shadows here. Every surface is lit equally, from no source. That is worse.
A sound behind you. You spin. Nothing. The sound was your name.
The walls pulse. Slowly. In time with something you cannot hear but your body recognizes.
This deep, the dungeon is aware of you. You are aware of the dungeon. You both wait.
A whisper. Not in your ear. In your chest. Not words. Intent.
The floor here is worn smooth by countless footsteps. None of them left.
Something has nested in this room and left. The nest is large. You are glad it left.
The darkness here is not an absence of light. It is a presence.
You feel a pressure behind your eyes. The dungeon is looking through them.
Every torch you light goes out before you can step away. You stop lighting them.

bosses.name: The Ashen Throne
bosses.phaseMsg2: The Ashen Throne cracks — the ruler within stirs, awakened by rage!
bosses.phaseMsg3: Fully awakened, the Ashen Throne rises from its fused seat — three centuries of fury!

bosses.name: The Cinder Colossus

bosses.phaseMsg3: Fully formed, the Cinder Colossus channels the entire eruption at you!

bosses.name: The Scorching Throne
bosses.phaseMsg2: The throne cracks and molten magma pours from every joint!
bosses.phaseMsg3: The Scorching Throne becomes pure fire. Unstoppable. Undying.

bosses.name: Pyrax the Deathless
bosses.phaseMsg2: Pyrax absorbs the fallen cinders around him — growing larger!
bosses.phaseMsg3: Pyrax transcends form entirely. He IS the fire now!

rooms: The ash here is ankle deep. Every step announces you.
Smoke rises from cracks in the floor. Whatever burned here has not finished burning.
The heat is immediate and wrong. The walls glow faintly orange.
Charred remains line the walls. They are standing upright. They were not placed that way.
The air tastes of cinder and something older than fire.
A fireplace dominates one wall. The fire inside burns black.
The ceiling is scorched in patterns. Not random. Something drew them with flame.
Your boots leave prints in the ash. Something else's prints are already here.
The room smells of burning hair. There is no hair. There is no source.
Embers drift upward from the floor. Gravity here has preferences.
A torch on the wall burns without fuel. You do not touch it.
The ash shifts as you walk through it. Like something underneath is listening.
Soot covers every surface. Writing in it. You cannot read it. You feel it means something.
The walls are warm to the touch. Not hot. Warm. Like skin.
This room has burned three times. You can tell by the layers.
The heat warps the air. Things at the edge of the room flicker like mirages.
A melted weapon lies in the corner. Whatever the owner fought, it was hotter than steel.
The floor crunches. Not ash. Something underneath the ash.
A bell hangs from the ceiling. Cracked and blackened. It rings once as you enter.
The smoke trails upward and then bends. Toward you.
The fire here is ancient. It has been burning longer than the dungeon has existed.
Handprints on the wall. Burned in, not painted. Someone reached for help.
The ash rises to your knees. Walking requires effort. Something benefits from that.
You hear breathing. Not yours. Rhythmic. Coming from the walls.
The room has no ceiling. Just darkness and falling ash from above.
Everything here is the same color: black and orange. Even the shadows.
A body here, preserved in char. The expression is not one of pain. It is surprise.
The fire follows you across the floor. Not chasing. Curious.
The air moves in circles here. Always circles. The center is perfectly still.
Three burned doors. The handles are too hot to touch. You find another way.
Voices in the crackle. Not words. Almost words.
The room is smaller than it should be. The walls crept inward while you were not watching.
Something feeds the fire. You cannot see what. You do not look closely.
The floor gives slightly under your weight. The ash is deep. Very deep.
A figure of ash stands in the corner. Detailed. It was made carefully.
The Wastes remember everyone who burned here. They remember you now.
The heat at this depth is not heat. It is intent.
Fire does not burn things at this depth. It reveals them.
You feel the ash on your skin before you realize you are breathing it.
The flames here do not flicker. They are absolutely still. That is wrong.
This deep, the fire is alive. It has been alive a very long time.
The burning never stopped. It started before the dungeon and it will end after.
You are a visitor. The fire is a resident. It tolerates your presence.
The walls melt as you watch. They reform. The shapes they form are faces.
Something in the fire looks back at you. You both pretend not to notice.
The ash here moves without wind. It has somewhere to be.
Your shadow burns on the wall. Your body does not. Not yet.
The fire whispers. Not words. A tone. It knows your name in frequencies.
At this depth the Wastes are not a dungeon. They are a hunger.
You realize you have been warm the entire time. The cold has not reached this deep. It never will.
The heat here is wrong — not warm, but hungry. Like the air itself wants to consume you.
Ash coats every surface inches deep. Your footsteps leave prints. Something else already has.
The walls are blackened stone, still faintly warm. Whatever burned here did not want to stop.
The smell of char and sulfur is overwhelming. You breathe through your teeth.
Scorched bones litter the floor. They were not arranged. They simply fell where their owners died.
An old fountain stands here, bone-dry. The stone basin is cracked from extreme heat.
The ceiling above you is stained black. Something burned for a very long time directly below it.
A child's sandal lies in the ash. You do not look for the other one.
The heat shimmers in visible waves. Distance is hard to judge. So is safety.
Melted iron is fused to the floor — what was once a gate, or a throne, or a cage.
The walls here have writing burned into them. The language is old. The warning is not.
Something glows red in the far corner. You move toward it because there is nowhere else to go.
The silence here is not cold and watching like the Crypt. It is hot and waiting.
Fragments of pottery. A broken cup. Someone tried to carry water through here. They did not make it.
You find a handprint burned into the wall at shoulder height. The fingers are spread. It did not want to leave.

bosses.name: The Eternal Winter
bosses.phaseMsg2: The Eternal Winter exhales — the temperature drops to absolute zero. Phase 2!
bosses.phaseMsg3: The cold stops being cold. It becomes something without a name. Final phase!

bosses.name: The Frozen King
bosses.phaseMsg2: The ice encasing the Frozen King cracks. He stirs. He remembers why he is angry!
bosses.phaseMsg3: Fully awake for the first time in a thousand years — and furious every second of it!

bosses.name: The Void Below
bosses.phaseMsg2: The Void Below tears through the ice floor. Phase 2: The abyss rises to meet you!
bosses.phaseMsg3: It is no longer rising. It is here. And it remembers you from before you were born!

bosses.name: The Glacier Queen
bosses.phaseMsg2: The Glacier Queen shatters her own crown and the shards orbit her like weapons!
bosses.phaseMsg3: Absolute zero. She freezes the very air between you!

bosses.name: Khyros the Frozen
bosses.phaseMsg2: Khyros splits into three frozen mirrors of himself!
bosses.phaseMsg3: The mirrors merge. Khyros is whole again — and furious!

rooms: Your breath comes out in clouds. Each exhale is stolen immediately by the cold.
The ice here is ancient — blue-black and deep. You can see something inside it. You try not to look.
The silence is not peaceful. It is the silence of a place that has never heard sound.
Your footsteps crack the ice beneath you. Whatever is below the surface, you hope it stays there.
Frost patterns on the walls form shapes. You tell yourself they are not faces.
A body stands frozen upright, still holding a torch that has been dark for centuries.
The temperature drops as you move forward. Something colder than cold waits ahead.
Stalactites of ice hang from the ceiling like teeth. The dripping has stopped.
The frost here smells wrong. Like iron and emptiness and something that has no name.
A crack runs floor to ceiling. The darkness on the other side is different.
Crystalline formations glow faintly. There is no light source. They glow anyway.
You find equipment left behind by someone. They did not leave voluntarily.
A thin layer of ice covers the floor. You can see shapes beneath it. Moving shapes.
The cold bites through your armor. It feels personal.
Your boots stick to the floor. You pull them free. The sound echoes too long.
A frozen pool in the center. The reflection shows the room differently than it is.
Icicles hang at perfect intervals. Too perfect. This was arranged.
The walls are mirrored with ice. Every reflection shows you a step behind where you are.
Something scratched at the ice from the other side of the wall. They did not get through.
The cold makes your thoughts slow. You notice too late that it is deliberate.
The cold is a presence here. Not weather. Not temperature. A thing that waits.
Ice formations block the path. You break through them. The sound echoes wrong.
At this depth, the cold becomes something else. You have no word for it.
The frozen air crackles with something like electricity. Like intention.
You hear breathing under the ice. Slow. Patient. Waiting for the ice to be thinner.
The frost on the walls shifts as you watch. Writing that was not there before.
A frozen door. The handle comes off in your hand. The door swings open anyway.
Light refracts through the ice in patterns. One of the patterns moves.
A frozen meal on a frozen table. The setting was for two. One chair is pushed back.
The floor here is perfectly clear ice. You can see down a very long way.
The cold seeps through your mind, not just your skin. It reads.
Frost blooms on every surface as you enter. The room was warm a moment ago.
A frozen waterfall. The water was moving when it froze. Something stopped it instantly.
The ceiling drips. The drops do not reach the floor. They freeze midway.
Two tunnels ahead. One exhales cold air. One inhales it. Both are wrong.
At this depth, the Abyss is not cold. Cold is how the Abyss says hello.
The frost here has memory. It remembers everyone who came before you.
The ice walls show frozen faces pressed from inside. They are reaching toward you.
The cold below zero is not temperature. It is the dungeon's oldest thought.
You cannot feel your hands. You check that they are still there. They are. For now.
The Void rises through the ice here. You can feel it looking up at you.
The ice is so old it has become something else. A mineral. A memory. A warning.
Every surface reflects differently. None of them are accurate. All of them are true.
The silence here has weight. It presses against your chest.
You are the warmest thing in this place by a magnitude that should not be survivable.
Something in the ice stirs as you pass. It has been sleeping. It dreams of heat.
The frost whispers. Not words. Directions. You do not follow them.
This deep, the cold is not an enemy. It is a philosophy.
The ice glows with an inner light. The light has been here longer than the dungeon.
The Abyss remembers every life that ended here. You feel them recognizing you.

bosses.name: The Drowned Curator
bosses.phaseMsg2: The Curator's waterlogged form swells. Ink floods the chamber.
bosses.phaseMsg3: Every book in the Archives screams at once. The Curator is what remains when knowledge drowns.

bosses.name: Leviathan of the Deep
bosses.phaseMsg2: The Leviathan surfaces. The floor cracks beneath the weight of what it is.
bosses.phaseMsg3: You realize it was always here. The Archives were built around it. Not on top of it. Around it.

bosses.name: The Last Librarian
bosses.phaseMsg2: She remembers everyone who ever read here. She remembers that they all drowned.
bosses.phaseMsg3: The pages of every book in the Archives turn at once. Her name is in all of them.

bosses.name: The Drowned Archivist
bosses.phaseMsg2: The Archivist tears pages from every book at once — they become weapons!
bosses.phaseMsg3: The forbidden pages ignite. Knowledge weaponized against you!

bosses.name: Tide Sovereign
bosses.phaseMsg2: The Tide Sovereign floods the chamber — you fight knee deep in dark water!
bosses.phaseMsg3: The water rises. He calls something from the deep!

loot.name: Barnacle Shield
loot.desc: Thick with centuries of ocean growth.

loot.name: Elixir of the Depths
loot.desc: Restores 60% of max HP. Drawn from an eternal spring below the Archives.

shop.name: Abyss Draught
shop.desc: From the deepest shelf. Restores 90 HP.

rooms: Water laps at your ankles. The bookshelves stretch into darkness above, warped and bloated.
A reading desk sits here, perfectly preserved. The candle on it is still lit. That is not possible.
The water is perfectly still. Your reflection looks at you a half-second too late.
Shelves of waterlogged texts line every wall. Something has been marking certain pages.
A cataloguing system covers the ceiling, handwritten in ink that has not faded.
The water here is darker. You cannot see the floor. You step forward anyway.
An open book floats past. The pages are blank until you look at them. Then filled. Then blank.
This chamber smells of salt and old paper. You are very deep and very far from any ocean.
Something large passed through recently. The displaced water still moves.
A reading chair sits in the center, facing away. It is occupied. Then it is not.
Thousands of index cards cover every surface. None of the books are where they say.
The torches here burn blue. The shadows are too defined.
A door of waterlogged wood. The handle is a hand. A real one. Reaching from the other side.
Bookshelves reach into the flooded ceiling, continuing upward into total submersion.
The water here tastes of ink. You close your mouth. You have already swallowed.
A librarian's desk, still organized. The appointment book is open to today.
You hear pages turning. Somewhere. The sound is deliberate.
Books float in neat rows, spine up. Organized by something. Not by size. Not by color.
The floor is tile. Under the water, you can read words in the grout between tiles.
A filing cabinet, open, empty. The drawer opened toward you on its own.
The deeper shelves contain books that have absorbed the water completely. They are the water now.
Something has been reading here. The chair is warm. In cold, deep water, it is warm.
A card catalogue cabinet, infinite rows, every card blank. Recently blank.
The water here moves against the current. Against any current. It moves toward a specific shelf.
A reading light, still on, still bright, still casting shadows of books that are not there.
The Archives remember you. You feel it in the water pressure. Adjusting.
Every book on one wall is open to the same page. You cannot read what is on that page.
A globe in the corner shows a world with more oceans than yours.
The index system covers everything here. Including a card for you. You do not read it.
Something enormous is shelved in the back of this room. It breathes.
The water level rises as you stand here. Slowly. Deliberately.
A single book on a pedestal, under glass. The glass is broken from the inside.
Chains hang from the ceiling. Books are chained to the chains. The books pull upward.
You hear a checkout stamp. Somewhere. The sound of a book being claimed.
The current in the water spells a word. You look away before you read it.
At this depth, the Archives do not archive knowledge. They archive everything.
The Leviathan has been through this room. The shelves curved around it.
Every book here is a record of something that should not have been recorded.
The water at this depth is not water. It is accumulated memory.
You feel catalogued. Something just filed you under a heading you cannot pronounce.
The lighting at this depth comes from the books themselves. They are not happy about it.
This deep, the Archives know you are here. They have updated your entry.
A door that opens to more water. Then more shelves. Then something looking back.
The restricted section is not a place. It is a state of mind. You are in it.
Something has been here for so long it has become part of the collection.
The Curator's presence is here. Not her body. Her intent. Her organization.
Every surface is catalogued. Including your face. Including the inside of your face.
The Archives contain the last thought of every person who drowned here.
At the deepest point, the water is still. The stillness has texture.
You are being cross-referenced. The filing never stops. Not even now.

t1.name: The Parlor Guest
t1.desc: It has been sitting in that chair since the house was built. It does not appreciate visitors.

t1.name: Hollow Bride
t1.desc: Still waiting. Still dressed. The flowers she carries are long dead. She is not.

t1.name: The Portrait
t1.desc: It watches from the wall. Every turn it watches, its next attack gets stronger.

t1.name: Creaking Step
t1.desc: You hear it before you see it. By the time you see it, it is already too late to flee.

t1.name: The Reflection
t1.desc: It copies your last action. Attack and it attacks. Defend and it heals.

t1.name: The Uninvited Guest
t1.desc: Nobody invited it. Nobody can make it leave.

t1.name: The Twin
t1.desc: It looks exactly like you. It knows exactly what you will do next.

t1.name: The Risen
t1.desc: It was buried in the grounds. It did not stay buried. It never does.

t2.name: The Door Warden
t2.desc: It guards every exit. Flee attempts automatically fail while it lives.

t2.name: The Music Box
t2.desc: When it plays, you cannot help but listen. Forces you to defend for one turn.

t2.name: The Groundskeeper
t2.desc: It has maintained these grounds for three hundred years. It takes its job very seriously.

t2.name: Hollow Groom
t2.desc: He waited at the altar for forty years. The anger calcified into something worse.

t2.name: The Bell Ringer
t2.desc: When the bell rings your turn is skipped. It always rings on the second turn.

t2.name: The Wall Crawler
t2.desc: It moves on the ceiling. Every other attack comes from above — impossible to block.

t2.name: The Pale Guest
t2.desc: It has not eaten in a long time. You can tell by the way it looks at you.

t3.name: The Oldest Guest
t3.desc: It arrived before the house existed. It will be here after it falls.

t3.name: The Hollow Matron
t3.desc: She ran this house. She still does. All enemies deal 10% more damage while she lives.

t3.name: The Caretaker
t3.desc: It has a key to every room. Including the ones that should not exist.

t3.name: The Unfinished
t3.desc: It did not finish what it started. It is still trying. Your attacks pass through it half the time.

bosses.name: The Grieving One
bosses.phaseMsg2: The Grieving One remembers something. The temperature drops. It hits harder now.
bosses.phaseMsg3: It is not grief anymore. It is something grief becomes when it has nowhere to go for long enough.

bosses.name: The House Itself
bosses.phaseMsg2: The walls close in. The house is not a location. The house is an entity. It has decided you are staying.
bosses.phaseMsg3: Every room is the same room now. You are in all of them at once.

bosses.name: The Last Resident
bosses.phaseMsg2: It has been alone here for a very long time. It does not want to be alone anymore.
bosses.phaseMsg3: It offers you a choice: stay, or face what staying means.

bosses.name: The Wedding Ghost
bosses.phaseMsg2: She removes her veil. What is underneath is not a face.
bosses.phaseMsg3: She begins to sing. The song pulls at something inside you.

bosses.name: The Portrait Lord
bosses.phaseMsg2: The Portrait Lord steps OUT of the frame. He should not be able to do that.
bosses.phaseMsg3: Reality tears where he walks. He was never meant to exist here.

loot.name: Tarnished Blade
loot.desc: Found in the study. Still sharp.

loot.name: The Last Candle
loot.desc: +10 SP. Do not let it go out.

loot.name: Old Locket
loot.desc: Worth 20 gold. Something inside it moves.

loot.name: Funeral Coin

rooms: The wallpaper peels in long strips. Something is written underneath in a handwriting you do not recognize.
A dining table set for twelve. Dust covers everything except one place setting, which is clean.
The grandfather clock in the corner has stopped. The pendulum moves anyway.
Children's drawings cover every wall. They all depict the same figure watching where you stand.
A fireplace burns without wood. The shadows it casts go in the wrong direction.
The mirror at the end of the hall shows this room. You are not in it.
Music plays from a room that does not exist on any floor plan. It gets louder anyway.
A guest book lies open. The most recent entry is dated today. It is your name.
The nursery. The crib is empty. Whatever was in it did not leave through the door.
The basement stairs. Something is at the bottom. It knows you are at the top.
Every clock in this room shows a different time. None of them are now.
The lights work. This is somehow more frightening than if they did not.
A rocking chair moves slowly. The window behind it is closed. There is no draft.
Family portraits line the walls. The subjects' eyes track your movement.
The kitchen. Everything is set to prepare a meal. No one is preparing it.
A locked room at the end of the hall. The key is in the lock. On the inside.
The upstairs hallway. All the doors are closed except the one at the end.
Toys arranged on the floor in a pattern. A warning or a welcome. You cannot tell.
A record player, winding down. You did not touch it. It was going when you arrived.
The smell of a meal cooking. No stove. No heat. No source.
The house has been expecting you. You feel it in the way the floorboards know your weight.
A phone on the wall rings. You answer. The sound on the other end is breathing. Yours.
The same room you were in before. Identical. But the door is on a different wall.
A child's laughter. Above. Below. All around. Gone before you turn.
The living room. Something has been living in it that is not alive.
Handprints in the dust on the mantle. Smaller than an adult. Smaller than a child.
A sewing basket, mid-project. The needle still threaded. The work unfinished for reasons.
The windows show a different yard than the house should have. Different sky.
A door that opens to a wall. Beyond the wall, someone breathes.
Old mail on the floor. Addressed to you. Postmarked before you were born.
The attic stairs. The pull-cord sways. Someone just came down.
Every chair in this room faces the same corner. Nothing is in the corner.
A typewriter. Mid-sentence. The sentence is about you.
The study. All the books have been opened, read, and replaced. Recently.
A doll sits in the center of the room. The doll's head turns as you cross the threshold.
The house has stopped pretending. It knows you know. You both drop the act.
At this depth, the Hollow shows what it is. A hunger wearing the shape of a home.
The wallpaper shows scenes. Moving scenes. Scenes from outside this dungeon.
The walls breathe. Slowly. The house is alive. It has always been alive.
Every room now opens to this room. You are in the center of something vast.
The family that lived here is still here. They are very glad you came.
The house remembers every tenant. It never lets any of them go.
The Heart of the Hollow beats somewhere below your feet. You can feel it.
The rooms repeat now. Different order. Different layout. The same dread.
The Hollow has been waiting for someone specific. You are wondering if it is you.
The shadows here are older than the house. The house was built around them.
At the deepest point, the house and the dungeon are the same thing.
Nothing in this room is real. Everything in this room is very, very dangerous.
The house shows you rooms from your memory. Accurate rooms. Private rooms.
The Hollow is complete. You are inside something that is complete and alive and watching.

rooms: The trees here are too close together. They were not always this close.
Something tied ribbons to the branches. The ribbons are moving. There is no wind.
The path behind you has already grown over. You noticed too late.
A sound like breathing comes from the roots. Slow. Patient.
The bark on every tree has been carved with the same word. You cannot read it.
Fireflies drift through the dark. They move in patterns. Deliberate ones.
The forest floor is soft here. Not from moss. From something beneath the moss.
A child's doll hangs from a branch. The face has been worn away by weather. Or something else.
The trees lean inward. Not from wind. They are listening.
Flowers grow in a perfect circle. Nothing grows inside the circle.
The air tastes of rain that has not fallen yet. Or rain that fell long ago.
Footprints lead to the center of the clearing. None lead out.
Something left claw marks on the trees at head height. From inside the trees.
The fog here moves against the direction you walk.
You hear your name. Once. Very clearly. From everywhere at once.
The branches above have grown together into something resembling a face.
Mushrooms grow in a spiral leading deeper in. You follow them.
The curse is visible here. A faint purple light that pulses like a heartbeat.
A cottage foundation. Burned long ago. The fire never left the stones.
The trees bleed sap that is the wrong color. You do not touch it.
Something has been building a nest in the canopy. The materials include things from inside houses.
The forest remembers the witch. You can feel it deciding what to do about you.
The roots above the surface form letters. You are reading someone's last words.
A well. Sealed. The seal is broken from the inside.
Every animal sound stopped exactly when you entered this part of the forest.
The witch's curse thickens here. The air is heavy with something you cannot name.
You find her altar. Overturned. Long ago. The offerings are still fresh.
The bark peels back to show wood that looks wrong. Organic. Living. Aware.
Three paths branch here. Two of them lead to the same place.
A lantern hangs from a branch. Still lit. Burning something other than oil.
The shadows do not match the trees that cast them.
Something has carved a map into the clearing floor. You are on it.
The witch is here. You cannot see her but you feel her. She has been waiting.
The forest is her now. Every tree. Every root. Every whisper. Her.
You have gone too deep for the forest to let you leave easily. It has not decided yet.
The air moves like breath. The forest is breathing. Around you. Through you.
The curse is complete at this depth. Beautiful. Absolute. You feel it working.
The trees here have faces. Old ones. They have seen everything that happened.
The witch's last words are written in bioluminescence on every surface.
This deep, the forest does not pretend. It watches openly. You watch back.
The roots crack beneath your feet but hold. Deliberately. The forest is not done with you.
You understand now why she cursed this place. You understand too late.
The final part of the forest. The part that even the witch feared.
Something has grown here that should not exist. You step carefully around it.
The whisper is deafening here. Your own name. Over and over. Getting louder.
The trees part to let you through. They close behind you. You are exactly where you need to be.
The heart of the curse. Everything led here. The forest holds its breath.

rooms: The darkness here is not an absence of light. It is a presence that chooses.
Something breathes in the corner. When you look, nothing. When you look away, it breathes.
The floor is warm. You do not investigate why.
A voice says your name. You are alone. Both of these things are true.
The walls are the wrong distance apart. You notice but cannot explain it.
You have been here before. You have never been here. Both are true.
The silence has weight. It presses against your chest.
Something left marks at eye level. You are not the right height for them.
The air smells like something that has not existed for a very long time.
Your shadow moves before you do.
There are doors here that were not here a moment ago.
The darkness watches you with what might be curiosity.
Something in the room is counting. You cannot find what.
You hear your own footsteps from a different direction.
A doorway opens in a wall that was solid a moment ago. The room beyond is darker.
The room is colder on the inside. Not from the outside. From within.
Three paths. All of them go to the same place. The place is not where any of them should go.
The air shimmers. Not heat. Something else. The shimmering watches back.
Something has recently stood exactly where you are standing. The floor remembers.
Your torch dims to nothing then brightens. It did not run out. It was dimmed.
The walls here pulse. Not visibly. You feel it in your teeth.
A corridor you did not enter this way. You entered from the other direction. Didn't you.
Something shifts in the peripheral. Always peripheral. Never center.
The room has no sharp edges. Everything is slightly curved. Slightly wrong.
A door that looks like it leads up opens to reveal another down.
You feel observed. Not from the room. From inside the room.
Time moves differently here. You have been in this room for a moment. Or an hour.
The floor gives slightly under pressure. Not from weight. From expectation.
The dark here is not black. It is a color you do not have a name for.
An intersection of three halls. All of them end at the same room. This room.
Something is being decided about you. You are not part of the decision.
The ceiling drips. The drops hang suspended and never fall.
You realize you have stopped blinking. You do not know when that happened.
A presence circles the room. Not walking. Not flying. Simply present in different spots.
Your heartbeat echoes. Slightly off rhythm. Not yours.
At this depth, the Infernal is not a dungeon. It is a conclusion.
The dark here is aware. Specifically, deliberately, personally aware.
Everything that has ever been feared ended up here eventually.
The walls are made of accumulated dread. Every explorer fed them.
You can feel every previous visitor. Their paths are grooves in the space here.
The Void is not below you. It is all around you. It has always been all around you.
Something ancient lives at this depth. It is not an enemy. It is the reason for enemies.
The room is not trying to frighten you. It simply is what it is. That is worse.
At the deepest point, there is no room. There is a thing that looks like a room.
The darkness here has texture. You feel it against your skin.
Everything is still. Not dead-still. Waiting-still. Deciding-still.
The Infernal remembers why it was made. You are the reason. You specifically.
You cannot tell how large this room is. The measurements keep changing.
The thing that lives here is not evil. It is honest. That is worse than evil.
You are at the end of something. You do not know what. The room knows.

rooms: The water here is ankle deep. Cold. Very cold. Something moves below the surface.
Bioluminescent moss lines the walls. It pulses slowly. Like breathing.
The pressure changes as you enter. Your ears pop. Something adjusts to your presence.
A skeleton sits against the wall in full armor. The armor is bent inward. From outside.
The water is perfectly still here. It should not be this still.
Something large passed through recently. The current still carries the memory of it.
Coral grows from the ceiling in patterns too regular to be natural.
A lanternfish drifts past your face and disappears into the dark. You are very deep.
The walls are covered in claw marks. All pointing the same direction. Down.
Salt crystals cover every surface. The room is older than anything above the water.
You hear something. Not a sound — a feeling. The ocean is aware of you.
An anchor the size of a house rests in the corner. No ship could have carried it here.
The light from your torch bends in the water. Things at the edges look wrong.
Teeth line the doorway. Not placed there. Grown there.
The floor is soft here. You do not look at what makes it soft.
A message is scratched into the wall. It reads: IT IS ALREADY BEHIND YOU.
Dead fish float near the ceiling in a perfect circle. Nothing disturbed them.
The pressure here is immense. You feel it in your chest. In your eyes.
Something is humming. You cannot find the source. The hum is getting louder.
The coral here has grown into the shape of a face. It was not always coral.
The water rises to your knees. Somewhere below a current pulls south.
A ghost ship is wedged in the walls somehow. Its flag still flies.
You find a compass at the bottom of the floor. It spins endlessly and stops pointing at you.
The bioluminescence dims as you enter. The room does not want to be seen.
Barnacles cover the walls so densely they form a texture like skin.
An old gramophone plays something at the bottom of the room. There is no record.
The shadow on the wall is not yours. It does not move when you do.
Something has been arranging the bones here. Into letters you recognize. Your name.
At this depth the darkness is absolute without your torch. Something lives in that darkness.
The walls pulse slowly. You realize you are inside something alive.
The Leviathan was here. The scratch marks are the size of doors.
Everything here is old. Older than the dungeon. Older than the ocean itself perhaps.
You find a journal from someone who came before. The last entry says: DO NOT GO DEEPER.
The water is warm here. That is wrong. That is very wrong.
